h:
此工作流程适用于低 VRAM GPU，例如 RTX 2060

放置 GGUF 模型文件（例如，Flux1-krea-dev-Q4_0.gguf）进入ComfyUI/模型/unet目录：https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/FLUX.1-Krea-dev-GGUF/blob/main/flux1-krea-dev-Q4_0.gguf

将 T5 XXL 编码器 GGUF 文件放入ComfyUI/模型/剪辑目录：https://huggingface.co/city96/t5-v1_1-xxl-encoder-gguf/blob/main/t5-v1_1-xxl-encoder-Q4_K_M.gguf

o.en:
this workflow works with low-Vram GPU's such as the RTX 2060

Place the GGUF model file (e.g.,flux1-krea-dev-Q4_0.gguf) into theComfyUI/models/unetdirectory:https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/FLUX.1-Krea-dev-GGUF/blob/main/flux1-krea-dev-Q4_0.gguf

Place the T5 XXL encoder GGUF file into theComfyUI/models/clipdirectory:https://huggingface.co/city96/t5-v1_1-xxl-encoder-gguf/blob/main/t5-v1_1-xxl-encoder-Q4_K_M.gguf
